name: Checkstand lane bank — the only seal zone this store needs. Clipped to the drawn lane bodies (measured x 398.1-790.1, y 554.4-597.6, padded ~4 pt): the aisle-block shelves north of it stop at y=547 and the next fixtures south of it start at y=619.6, so the front action alley (y 533-552) and the front walkway toward Blooms/ICE/the entrances both stay open. Lanes are wider than a service-counter pass-through, hence bridge 20 as at 659. The derived zones are NOT carried over on purpose: (a) the derived CHECKSTANDS rect ran y 492-605, which swallowed the action alley and the south ends of aisles 44-54; (b) the derived DELI/BAKERY/SEAFOOD disks (r=130) sealed their blocks correctly but their rims also guillotined the aisle 41/42 Frozen corridors, two Beer & Wine cross-gaps and a strip of Produce floor — those three blocks are drawn as closed rooms, so exclusions.json (Deli/Bakery) and the PDF's own walls (Seafood) seal them exactly, with no rim; (c) the derived KITCHEN disk was a phantom — see inclusions.json
